attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Localized fix that clones a cached ContentItem before display to avoid cross-request mutation, but the new Clone() method only copies a subset of properties, so any display driver or part relying on fields not explicitly copied (rather than Data) on the cloned widget item could behave differently."}
